title: Gully meets him
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Gully and the dog. Instant. Wood watches an alliance form.

panels.composition: The boat launch. GULLY on the dock. WOOD arriving with BARNABY on the leash. The dog sees Gully and goes flat-out.

image.prompt: a small dog lunging joyfully toward a boy in a backwards cap on a wooden dock, dragging a young man in a chore coat by the leash, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Gully on one knee, the dog all over him.

balloons.text: Barnaby. He was behind the Lanes.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap kneeling on a dock laughing while a scruffy dog climbs all over him

panels.composition: Gully, producing a maple bar from his jacket. Barnaby's entire soul.

image.prompt: close-up of a boy holding out a maple bar to a transfixed small dog, a hand reaching to stop him too late

panels.composition: The dock. Gully and the dog sitting at the edge, feet and paws over the water. Wood behind them, drawing, already knowing which of them the dog will love more.

image.prompt: a boy in a backwards cap and a small dog sitting side by side on the edge of a dock over the water, a young man behind them drawing, black and white

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
